product.industry: Physician-led healthspan clinic offering contextual assessment and coordinated preventive care
product.audience: An informed adult who wants a credible starting point without wellness hype, diagnostic theatre, or an indiscriminate test menu
product.decision: Choose an appropriate care pathway and understand what the first 90 days would involve
product.conversion: Assemble a non-diagnostic starting brief, select a care pathway, and submit an inline consultation request with a confirmation reference

signature.moment: Priority, pace, setting, and follow-up preference resolve into a plain-language care brief with focus areas, cadence, pathway, preparation, and transparent starting estimate

systems.hero: A single-viewport split clinical file: useful service facts and a compact sample brief sit beside one documentary portrait, with no pinned scroll film or giant circular action
systems.navigation: A thin appointment-status bar and rectangular file tabs; mobile uses a compact care index disclosure that expands below the header instead of a full-screen overlay
systems.contentDensity: Operational labels, clinical caveats, and compact comparisons lead; documentary imagery creates calm intervals without long empty cinematic scroll
systems.geometry: Rectangular casefile panels, tabbed edges, ruled rows, check columns, and an asymmetric 12-column grid; no round portals, floating stickers, pill clouds, or giant circular CTAs
systems.motion: Finite file-assembly transitions occur only after user input; selection highlights and result panels settle with short opacity and transform changes, with no parallax, marquee, or perpetual loop
systems.coreInteraction: A guided non-diagnostic brief builder turns priority, pace, setting, and review cadence into a contextual pathway recommendation and an editable consultation handover

structuralDifferences: The first fold starts with service facts and Start your brief; the portrait becomes a shallow documentary strip rather than a dominant full-screen hero
The brief builder becomes one question at a time with an explicit progress label and Back or Continue controls instead of the desktop's simultaneous assessment board
Pathways become a compact comparison ledger with a sticky selected-summary row rather than stacked pricing cards
Consultation is an inline final passport page with validation and confirmation, never a side drawer or bottom sheet

artDirection.typography: Local system grotesk for readable clinical UI, Georgia only for short human notes, and ui-monospace for measurements and file labels; hierarchy comes from grids, rule weight, and indentation rather than enormous uppercase display type
artDirection.material: Warm clinical paper, burgundy annotation ink, pale mineral glass, charcoal rules, and translucent evidence layers with squared and tabbed edges
artDirection.imageLogic: Four local documentary or sculptural WebP images each have one role; CSS renders file tabs, context nodes, pathway checks, and progress marks so informational graphics remain semantic and recolorable
artDirection.microcopy: Calm operational language such as starting brief, lived signals, clinical context, review cadence, care handover, and appropriate next step, with specialist terms explained in plain English
artDirection.dataHonesty: All scores, pathway matching, availability, estimates, and biomarker values are explicitly labelled illustrative template data and never presented as diagnosis, risk prediction, or guaranteed outcome

interactions.name: Starting brief builder
interactions.input: Visitor selects a current priority, preferred pace, consultation setting, and review cadence
interactions.stateChange: A deterministic local matcher updates focus areas, preparation steps, pathway, ninety-day cadence, and indicative starting estimate
interactions.visibleResult: A named starting brief appears with an explicit non-diagnostic caveat and can be carried into the consultation handover

interactions.name: Consultation handover
interactions.input: Visitor confirms the selected pathway, provides name, email, and a short goal, then acknowledges that the request is not urgent medical care
interactions.stateChange: Accessible validation identifies incomplete fields; valid local submission stores the selected brief in the confirmation state
interactions.visibleResult: An inline confirmation announces reference NN-2608 and repeats the selected pathway, location, and next-step boundary

assetStrategy: Reuse the four coordinated local WebP assets as a one-image-per-role clinical storyboard; use semantic CSS rather than additional decorative bitmap filler

assets.role: Human context portrait for the first-fold care brief, signalling that the visitor's lived experience comes before measurements
assets.focalCrop: Wide split crop preserves the subject on the right and leaves the limestone field for file annotations
assets.mobileSafeArea: Shallow 16:7 strip keeps the face and burgundy jacket in the right two-thirds without placing text over the face

assets.role: Sculptural evidence object for the context map, showing measures as connected rather than ranked
assets.focalCrop: Portrait crop preserves the full suspended glass system and dark negative space
assets.mobileSafeArea: Square crop protects the central connected discs and stone base

assets.role: Documentary proof of the long-consultation environment and physical accessibility
assets.focalCrop: Portrait crop retains consultation desk, exam couch, curved glass, and natural light
assets.mobileSafeArea: Landscape crop keeps desk and couch together in the central 80 percent

assets.role: A calm care-cadence interval showing recovery support as one optional environment, not a universal treatment claim
assets.focalCrop: Portrait architectural crop holds the red alcove between cyan and stone walls
assets.mobileSafeArea: Square crop preserves the bench, red light, and material contrast

adjacentTemplates.why: The current build uses a 260vh pinned portrait hero, giant display slogans, circular actions, three pricing cards, a long cinematic place section, and a consultation drawer; the redesign is a compact casefile system with a guided brief and inline handover

Marigold is a conventional primary-care marketing page with illustration, service cards, doctor profiles, testimonials, and mail links; North / Now becomes an operational healthspan planning product with contextual data and a complete local workflow

Matter & Means uses a dark deal terminal, thesis matrix, portfolio ledger, and founder signal; the clinic uses warm clinical paper, a progressive care passport, evidence context map, pathway comparison, and consultation handover

MARA/0 is a player-first performance world with waveform, tracks, tour tickets, and cart; the clinic is a document-led care workflow with finite input-driven transitions and no persistent media control

Serein is a gesture-first full-screen lookbook with chapter ribbon, product fitting, cart, and appointment flow; the clinic prioritises readable care evidence, tabbed files, row comparisons, and an inline health handover

avoid: Pinned multi-screen hero, giant uppercase manifesto, decorative pulse rings, or circular CTA language
Three tall pricing cards, pill filters, right-side consultation drawer, or generic full-screen menu overlay
Score gamification, risk prediction, biological-age claims, diagnosis, treatment promises, or unlabelled live-looking biomarker data
Mobile as a one-column desktop collapse with 16vw headings and repeated 65vh image crops
Heavy sans uppercase paired with decorative italic serif as the primary identity
External runtime fonts, expiring assets, auto-playing motion, or essential content hidden behind animation
